build_image_gradient_module: build a PyTorch module that computes Scharr x and y gradients on multi-channel image tensors
build_gaussian_blur_module: build a PyTorch module that applies a 3x3 Gaussian blur kernel to multi-channel image tensors
build_image_pyramid_module: build a Gaussian image pyramid by repeatedly blurring and downsampling a tensor across levels
build_depth_pyramid_module: build a depth pyramid by repeatedly downsampling depth tensors using pyr_depth across levels
build_intrinsics_pyramid_module: build a camera intrinsics pyramid by scaling K matrices for each pyramid level
